scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the complete set of expected shear and breathing mode frequencies from the public bilayer frequencies (19.2 and 27.8 cm⁻¹) using the linear chain formula and compares against the agent's reported table with a 0.1 cm⁻¹ tolerance. Force constants Kx, Kz are compared to the paper's reported values (3.6×10^19 and 7.5×10^19 N/m³) within 1% relative tolerance. No hidden holdout is needed; the recompute uses only the input constants the agent already possesses.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference force constant values K_x (3.6×10^19 N/m³) and K_z (7.5×10^19 N/m³) as reported by the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper text: Section 3 states K_x = 3.6×10^19 N/m³, K_z = 7.5×10^19 N/m³.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's own calculation results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own headline computed quantities, taken from the article.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the computed interlayer force constants (K_x, K_z) and a list of all calculated Raman-active shear and breathing mode frequencies for layer counts 2 through 7 and bulk (N=100). The verifier will recompute K_x and K_z from the bilayer input constants, recompute the frequency table from the agent's K_x/K_z, and compare the frequencies against the paper's experimentally measured frequencies.

output_contract.notes: The task uses a pure analytical model; no external datasets are required. The solving agent must implement the model and produce the structured artifact. All input constants are provided in the instruction.

steps.description: Validate force constants K_x, K_z against paper reference and recompute all mode frequencies from public bilayer inputs, checking consistency with agent's table.
